title: Local sessions stop failing on the GitHub plugin's empty token
why: A mailaudit session's finding, Oct 26: the GitHub plugin sends 'Bearer ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}' with the variable unset, so GitHub's MCP server refuses it on every local session.
note: Ruling, Oct 27 12:07 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 35): (b), try a token once on the Mac and see what it adds before choosing. Finding, Oct 27 12:09 CDT (local liaison): the GitHub plugin is not on the Mac at all (plugin list, MCP list and every repo's settings checked), so the empty-token failure is on Windows. You said Oct 28 02:36 CDT (item 7) it fails on your Mac too, and asked whether a personal access token expired; the liaison had found no GitHub plugin on the Mac, so another GitHub connection may be the failing piece; in the cloud the plugin fails with "Authorization header is badly formatted" while gh works (orchestrator, Oct 28). Ruling, Oct 28 02:43 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 7, a): a Mac session lists every GitHub connection on the Mac, checks each token (gh auth status, expiry) and reports which one fails and why, changing nothing; the fix follows from the cause. Waits on: a local session. Checked claude-settings main 54be9f1: its enabledPlugins does not list a GitHub plugin. The fix lands in claude-settings so every machine gets it. Port: no; global settings install everywhere. Placed ahead of c54, after c47 (triage, Oct 26): both are local setup on your machines.
